answer: The fable schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the relic checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 35 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Someone wanting 58 effective identities must lock that capital for 35 epochs and keep it locked through every lantern audit. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
